_about: What was decided by ear, for build.py and regions.py. 'confirmed': a start heard by ear (phoneme decode, listen.py) where no matcher could confirm it -- [seconds, why]. 'rejected': a move the tools made that listening showed wrong -- the ayah opens with words the ayah before also says, and what was heard was the ayah before. 'regions': a measured stretch corrected by hand -- a caption split out where an ayah was heard folded into another.
